痛点区标题.zh: 为什么不能直接用 ChatGPT？

痛点 1.zh: 知识孤岛 —— 核心数据散落在文档、数据库和员工经验里，通用 AI 拿不到，也用不好。→ Cyano 把企业知识接入、清洗、建立带权限的索引。
痛点 1.en: Knowledge silos — your critical data lives in documents, databases and people's heads. Generic AI can't reach it. → Cyano connects, cleans and indexes your knowledge with permissions built in.

痛点 2.zh: 上下文受限 —— 信息喂不全就会产生幻觉，复杂任务越做越偏。→ Cyano Core 在有限窗口内只装入最相关的信息。
痛点 2.en: Limited context — incomplete context breeds hallucinations and drift. → Cyano Core fits only the most relevant information into every request.

痛点 3.zh: 输出不可控 —— 同一个问题不同答案，企业不敢把它用在合同与财务流程上。→ 每个工作流都有校验规则、引用溯源和人工审核点。
痛点 3.en: Unpredictable output — same question, different answers. Not acceptable for contracts or finance. → Every workflow has validation rules, citations and human checkpoints.

痛点 4.zh: 无法规模化 —— 靠个别员工的 Prompt 技巧只能救急，无法沉淀为组织能力。→ 我们把 SOP 固化为可复用、可审计的系统。
痛点 4.en: No way to scale — individual prompting skills don't become company capability. → We turn your SOPs into reusable, auditable systems.

总览 Hero 标题.zh: 两类 AI 机会，四条落地路径
总览 Hero 标题.en: Two kinds of AI opportunity. Four proven paths.

总览 Hero 导语.zh: Cyano 不为用 AI 而用 AI。我们先判断这是一项新能力，还是一个降本增效的机会，再决定做成工具、工作流还是托管服务。
总览 Hero 导语.en: We never use AI for its own sake. First we work out whether it's a new capability or an efficiency gain — then we decide whether it should be a tool, a workflow or a managed service.

机会 1.zh: 过去做不了，现在能做 —— AI 让个性化推荐、精准获客、客户画像和一客一稿的销售材料第一次可以规模化。标签：个性化找客户 · 精准定位客群 · 一客一稿 · 新增服务能力
机会 1.en: What wasn't possible before — AI makes personalization, precise targeting, customer profiling and one-to-one sales content possible at scale. Tags: Personalized prospecting · Precise targeting · One-to-one content · New service lines

机会 2.zh: 已经在做，但成本太高 —— 把文档、审核、查询、客服、运营等重复流程变成 AI 工作流，减少人工、返工和等待。标签：文档自动化 · 合同与合规审查 · 内部知识问答 · 数据查询与运营
机会 2.en: What you already do, but at too high a cost — turn repetitive work in documents, review, search, support and operations into AI workflows. Tags: Document automation · Contract & compliance review · Internal Q&A · Data & operations

不在清单上？.zh: 你的场景不在上面？我们同样承接垂直场景定制，例如房产管理与长篇内容创作。多数项目都从一次业务诊断开始。
不在清单上？.en: Don't see your use case? We also build for specialized domains such as property management and long-form content creation. Most projects start with a diagnosis.

Hero 标题.zh: 先算清楚值不值得做，再决定怎么合作
Hero 标题.en: First, find out if it's worth building. Then decide how.

Hero 导语.zh: 每个行业、每条流程的 AI 机会都不一样。我们先研究你现在的工作方式，算清楚投入与回报，再推荐最合适的合作模式。
Hero 导语.en: Every industry and workflow is different. We study how you work today, size the return, and only then recommend how to engage.

怎么选.zh: 想沉淀长期能力，选完整定制；想先验证价值，从低启动试点开始；想马上释放团队人力，托管式服务最快见效。
怎么选.en: Want to own the capability long-term? Build it. Want to prove value first? Start with a pilot. Need capacity now? Managed service is the fastest route.

SaaS 托管.zh: 即刻接入，弹性扩展。隔离的云端环境，适合快速验证与轻量场景。
SaaS 托管.en: Fast to start, elastic to scale. An isolated cloud environment for quick validation and lighter workloads.

私有化部署.zh: 数据不出你的环境，模型本地运行。完整的 Docker 交付与本地算力适配，满足数据主权与合规要求。
私有化部署.en: Your data never leaves your environment. Models run on-premises with full Docker delivery and local compute support.

应该完整定制，还是从试点开始？ / Full build or pilot fi.zh: 目标明确、使用频率高，可以直接规划完整系统；场景还在探索，就先用低启动试点快速验证价值，用真实反馈决定下一步。
应该完整定制，还是从试点开始？ / Full build or pilot fi.en: If the goal is clear and usage is high, plan the full system. If you're still exploring, start with a pilot and let real results decide the next step.

什么时候适合托管式 AI 服务？ / When does managed ser.zh: 当你更关心稳定产出，而不想自己组建团队维护系统时。Cyano 用 AI 工作流加人工审核，直接交付结果。
什么时候适合托管式 AI 服务？ / When does managed ser.en: When you care about reliable output more than running the system yourself. We combine AI workflows with human review and deliver the results.

前期诊断会带来什么？ / What does the diagnosis giv.zh: 我们会梳理你的流程、数据来源和团队协作方式，找到 AI 最值得接入的位置，给出清晰、可执行的建设路径。
前期诊断会带来什么？ / What does the diagnosis giv.en: A clear map of your workflow, data and team, the places where AI pays off most, and an actionable path to get there.

如何获得适合自己的方案？ / How do we get a tailored.zh: 联系我们后，我们会根据业务价值、技术复杂度、使用规模和上线节奏，给出贴合实际的建议与报价。
如何获得适合自己的方案？ / How do we get a tailored.en: Talk to us. We tailor the recommendation and quote to your business value, technical complexity, scale and timeline.

数据安全如何保障？ / How is our data protected?.zh: 支持私有化部署，数据不出你的环境；系统内置权限控制、全链路日志审计与敏感信息拦截。
数据安全如何保障？ / How is our data protected?.en: Private deployment keeps data inside your environment. Every system includes access control, full audit logs and sensitive-data filtering.

上线之后谁来维护？ / Who maintains it after launc.zh: 三种合作模式都包含上线后的维护与迭代；托管式服务由 Cyano 全面负责。
上线之后谁来维护？ / Who maintains it after launc.en: All three models include post-launch maintenance and iteration. With managed service, Cyano runs everything.

如果效果不达预期怎么办？ / What if results fall shor.zh: 我们先诊断、再试点。试点阶段双方共同定义验收标准，用真实数据看到效果后，再决定是否扩大投入。
如果效果不达预期怎么办？ / What if results fall shor.en: We diagnose first and pilot second. Acceptance criteria are agreed up front, and you decide whether to scale only after seeing real results.

Hero 标题.zh: 工程能力不是装饰，是稳定交付的底座
Hero 标题.en: Engineering isn't decoration. It's what makes delivery reliable.

Hero 导语.zh: 长上下文、知识召回、Agent 编排、成本与延迟、权限与部署 —— 这些决定了 AI 能不能真正进入业务。
Hero 导语.en: Long context, retrieval, agent orchestration, cost and latency, permissions and deployment — these decide whether AI actually makes it into your business.

Cyano Core 定义.zh: Cyano Core 是我们在每个项目中使用的企业 AI 工程平台：把企业数据变成可检索的知识，把 SOP 变成可执行的工作流，并让每一次输出都可追溯、可审计。
Cyano Core 定义.en: Cyano Core is the enterprise AI engineering platform behind every project we ship: it turns your data into searchable knowledge, your SOPs into executable workflows, and makes every output traceable and auditable.

第 1 层.zh: 知识摄入 —— 连接 PDF、数据库、API 等多源数据，建立带权限管理的动态索引。
第 1 层.en: Ingestion — connects PDFs, databases and APIs into a permission-aware, continuously updated index.

第 2 层.zh: 上下文编排 —— 在有限的 Token 预算内，自动筛选并拼装最相关的信息。
第 2 层.en: Context orchestration — selects and assembles only the most relevant information within the token budget.

第 3 层.zh: 任务执行 —— 把 SOP 固化为 Playbook，包含标准步骤、校验规则与兜底机制。
第 3 层.en: Execution — encodes SOPs as playbooks with defined steps, validation rules and fallbacks.

第 4 层.zh: 企业级治理 —— 全链路日志审计、引用溯源、敏感信息拦截。
第 4 层.en: Governance — end-to-end audit logs, source citations and sensitive-data filtering.

难题 1.zh: 成本失控 —— 对话越长，全量历史传输让 API 成本成倍上升。
难题 1.en: Cost explosion — as conversations grow, resending full history multiplies API cost.

难题 2.zh: 首字延迟 —— 上下文过载，让第一个字迟迟出不来，实时交互体验崩溃。
难题 2.en: Latency spikes — overloaded context delays the first token and breaks real-time interaction.

难题 3.zh: 中间迷失 —— 信息越多，模型越容易忽略中间的关键指令。
难题 3.en: Lost in the middle — more data makes models miss the instructions that matter.

估值引擎标题.zh: 智能上下文估值引擎：像操作系统管理内存一样，管理 Agent 的长期记忆。
估值引擎标题.en: The context valuation engine: managing agent memory the way an OS manages RAM.

指标 1.zh: < 200ms* —— 响应延迟，第 1 轮与第 100 轮一样快
指标 1.en: < 200ms* — response latency, as fast at turn 100 as at turn 1

指标 3.zh: 最多 40%* —— Token 成本降低

指标 4.zh: 最高 10 倍* —— 投入回报

对比表标题.zh: 从个人技巧，到系统能力
对比表标题.en: From individual tricks to company capability

对比表行.zh: 驱动核心：个人灵感与技巧 → 企业知识库 + SOP；稳定性：随机，难以复现 → 稳定、可审计、可复用；模型关系：绑定特定模型 → 模型无关；可迁移性：跟不上模型迭代 → 始终使用当下最合适的模型
对比表行.en: Driven by: individual skill → company knowledge + SOPs; Stability: random, hard to reproduce → consistent, auditable, reusable; Model dependency: tied to one model → model-agnostic; Portability: falls behind every model release → always on the best model available

收尾.zh: 和我们的技术负责人聊聊你的数据与部署要求。
收尾.en: Talk to our CTO about your data and deployment requirements.

使命句.zh: 让企业的知识流动起来，变成每天都在创造价值的 AI 系统。
使命句.en: We make company knowledge flow — into AI systems that create value every day.

我们是谁 1.zh: Cyano（澜屿智创）是一支企业 AI 工程团队，服务中国与北美的企业客户。我们为企业定制 AI 工具、AI 工作流与托管式 AI 服务，专注于把 AI 用进销售、文档、知识管理和数据分析等核心业务流程。
我们是谁 1.en: Cyano is an enterprise AI engineering team serving clients in China and North America. We build custom AI tools, workflows and managed AI services that put AI to work in sales, documents, knowledge management and analytics.

我们是谁 2.zh: 团队的每一位核心成员都有 6 年以上开发经验、AI 模型研发经验和世界 500 强企业的工作经历。我们既懂模型，也懂企业系统是怎样在真实环境里运转的。
我们是谁 2.en: Every core member has 6+ years of engineering, hands-on AI model R&D, and experience at Fortune Global 500 companies. We understand models — and how enterprise systems actually run.

名字的由来正文.zh: Cyano 取自 cyan —— 青色，冷静、精确、清澈。我们的中文名“澜屿”，澜是流动的波澜，屿是海中的岛屿。企业的知识像一座座孤岛，散落在文档、系统和员工的经验里；我们做的，是让知识像波澜一样在岛屿之间流动起来，变成每天都能用上的能力。
名字的由来正文.en: Cyano comes from cyan — calm, precise, clear. Our Chinese name, 澜屿 (Lán Yǔ), means “waves and islands.” Company knowledge sits on islands: in documents, in systems, in people's heads. Our job is to make it flow between them, like waves — and turn it into something your team uses every day.

原则 4.en: Built to last — as models evolve, your system keeps up.
